'''Bellana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Freebooter's Trade Union]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She often represented the Trade Union on both [[Carrick Station]] and [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Bellana was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Game Update 3.0. She serves as the Reputation Vendor for the Freebooter's Trade Union, the Reputation group added for the Shadow Packs that premiered in Update 3.0.<ref name="TOR" />
